200.description: Staffing gap for this path within the committed plan.

observedIdlePct.description: The observed idle share (a fraction in [0, 1], NOT a 0-100 percentage) for this path's task type, fed back from labor-performance's idleness signal via LABOR_PERFORMANCE_MODE=kafka-cache. Omitted entirely -- never a fabricated 0 -- when no idle-share signal is available: the mode isn't kafka-cache, or no observation has been recorded yet for this task type.

400.description: Malformed JSON body, or a required field was missing/empty (empty-associate-id, empty-path-id, empty-certification, missing-building-id, missing-shift-id, missing-charge, or malformed-request-body).
